_comment: Item registry harvested from the mod jars on the server (item.<ns>.<name> lang keys). Seeds the tier list universe so items nothing references yet still get tiered. Refresh with: ops/loot-tiers/refresh_registry.sh Also carries `blocks` (block.<ns>.<name> lang keys) so pure-decor blocks can be kept out of the list.

tooltips.mega_showdown:tapunium_z: Z-Crystal associated with the tapu and allows them to upgrade their Nature's Madness into the special Z-Move Guardian of Alola
tooltips.mega_showdown:tera_orb: Orb that allows a Trainer to Terastallize their Pokémon, temporarily changing its type and boosting its moves
tooltips.mega_showdown:toxic_plate: A tablet that raises the power of Poison-type moves. When held by Arceus, it changes to the Poison type
tooltips.mega_showdown:tyranitarite: Allows Tyranitar to Mega Evolve into Mega Tyranitar
tooltips.mega_showdown:ultranecrozium_z: Z-Crystal associated with Necrozma which allows it to transform into Ultra Necrozma after fusing with Solgaleo or Lunala, and also allows it to upgrade its Photon Geyser into the signature Z-Move Light That Burns the Sky when it is Ultra Necrozma
tooltips.mega_showdown:venusaurite: Allows Venusaur to Mega Evolve into Mega Venusaur
tooltips.mega_showdown:water_memory: A disc with Water-type data. It changes Silvally's type
tooltips.mega_showdown:water_tera_shard: Used to change a Pokémon’s Tera Type to the Water Tera Type
tooltips.mega_showdown:waterium_z: Z-Crystal associated with the Water type and allows Pokémon to upgrade their Water-type moves to Z-Moves
tooltips.mega_showdown:wellspring_mask: A sacred mask infused with the power of flowing water, boosting a Pokémon's agility and recovery
tooltips.mega_showdown:wishing_star: A mysterious stone said to grant Pokémon the power to Dynamax when embedded in a Dynamax Band
tooltips.mega_showdown:yellow_nectar: A flower nectar that changes Oricorio to its Pom-Pom Style
tooltips.mega_showdown:z_power_ring: Bracelet that allows a Trainer and their Pokémon to gather the Z-Power required to perform Z-Moves
